narrative.overview:
Cota is engineered as an instrument-grade desktop workbench built directly on the shadcn/ui (base-mira style + neutral base color) token architecture. The application chrome recedes into an achromatic structural frame, allowing live PTY terminals, Git diffs, and coding-agent telemetry to command full visual priority. Every surface is calibrated for multi-hour engineering focus: zero-chroma OKLCH grayscale steps establish spatial hierarchy, while compact 28px (h-7) interactive rows and crisp 1px hairlines maximize information density without visual clutter.

Rather than relying on decorative gradients, glowing AI borders, or heavy frosted-glass blurs, Cota treats color and motion as scarce operational signals. When a pixel carries chroma or animation—such as a pulsing sky-blue agent indicator (--dot-status-working), an amber input-required dot (--dot-status-attention), or a green/red diff stat—it communicates a concrete machine state that demands developer awareness.
keyCharacteristics: Built on shadcn/ui (style: "base-mira", baseColor: "neutral") with 1:1 CSS custom property parity in src/renderer/src/styles.css.
Frame-in-frame desktop shell with a recessed outer frame (bg-muted: oklch(0.97 0 0) light / oklch(0.269 0 0) dark) and an inset top-left rounded canvas (bg-background, 18px radius).
Zero-chroma OKLCH neutral foundation (oklch(L 0 0)) paired with domain-prefixed semantic status signals (--dot-status-*, --source-control-*, --file-icon-*).
Instrument-grade compact density (28px standard control and tree-row height, 12px primary UI copy, tabular-nums numeric alignment).
Progressive disclosure of secondary actions on hover or keyboard focus and focus-aware split-pane dimming (0.8 opacity on unfocused terminal panes).

rules.name: The Mira Preset Integrity Rule
rules.body: Never repurpose or alter the semantic role of canonical base-mira tokens (background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, input, ring, sidebar-*). Keep custom domain tokens in the dedicated app-specific block of src/renderer/src/styles.css.

rules.name: The Scoped Token Naming Rule
rules.body: New custom CSS variables must follow <domain>-<element>-<role/state> in kebab-case—such as --dot-status-*, --source-control-*, --terminal-*, --file-icon-*, or --window-*—and be registered in @theme inline as --color-<name>: var(--<name>) when needed as Tailwind utility classes.

rules.name: The Dynamic Mixture Rule
rules.body: Hover and active surface states derive from color-mix(in oklab/oklch, ...) against var(--foreground) or var(--input) (e.g., --muted-hover, --accent-hover, --background-hover, --terminal-tab-hover) rather than hardcoded hex steps, ensuring automatic adaptation across light, dark, and custom-tinted themes.

rules.name: The Signal-Only Chroma Rule
rules.body: Saturated colors are strictly reserved for operational telemetry: live agent states (--dot-status-*), Git diff additions/deletions (--source-control-*), validation alerts (--destructive, --warning, --success), and file-extension icons (--file-icon-*).

rules.name: The Compact Scale Rule
rules.body: Following shadcn/ui base-mira conventions, primary operational controls, tabs, and tree items default to 12px (text-xs/relaxed) rather than web-marketing 16px, preserving vertical room for terminal scrollback and file trees.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: All numeric indicators—Git +add / -del counts, port numbers, and quota metrics—must apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns never jitter during live updates.

rules.name: The Bidirectional Path Rule
rules.body: File names, relative paths, and branch refs must apply unicode-bidi: plaintext and truncate to prevent mixed CJK/ASCII/symbol path strings from corrupting layout order.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Structural panels, cards, and list rows cast zero drop shadow at rest; spatial separation is achieved strictly via oklch surface contrast and 1px border-border lines.

rules.name: The Invisible Handle Rule
rules.body: Panel resize handles (.ui-resizable-handle) are 1px wide and transparent at rest with an 8px hit target, illuminating into a 2px --panel-separator-hover (var(--accent-hover)) or --panel-separator-active (var(--ring)) line only during pointer hover, drag, or keyboard focus.

dos: Do use canonical shadcn/ui base-mira tokens (bg-background, bg-muted, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground, border-border, bg-sidebar-accent) for all standard surfaces and controls.

Do name any new custom CSS token in src/renderer/src/styles.css using <domain>-<element>-<state/role> (e.g., --dot-status-*, --source-control-*, --terminal-*, --file-icon-*), place it under the app-specific comment block, and expose it in @theme inline if utility classes are needed.

Do reuse shadcn/ui and @base-ui/react primitives (Button, FieldGroup, Field, Dialog, Tabs, Collapsible) and assign semantic, module-descriptive className hooks (e.g., project-folder-row, source-control-file-actions).
Do keep tree rows and file lists at 28px height with content-visibility: auto and hide row-level action buttons until :hover or :focus-within.
Do cancel Electron titlebar drag behavior (-webkit-app-region: no-drag) on all interactive controls, open dropdown/context menus, and portaled dialog overlays.
donts: Don't introduce parallel token aliases (such as surface-canvas or recessed-shell) in component classes when a canonical base-mira token (background, muted, secondary) already serves that role.
Don't introduce decorative gradients, neon AI glows, glassmorphism (backdrop-filter: blur), or multi-layered ambient drop shadows onto workspace panels or cards.
Don't hardcode hex or Tailwind palette classes (such as bg-slate-100 or text-zinc-500) in component JSX; always bind to semantic tokens (bg-muted, text-app-muted-foreground, text-text-normal).

Don't unmount the TerminalWorkspace DOM tree when toggling file previews, Git diffs, or secondary pages (/settings, /cortana); toggle visibility via CSS (hidden) to preserve live xterm buffers and WebGL contexts.
